title: Topic 2 ● 家事
japanese_text:
A：最近、母が家事を手伝ってうるさくて。
B：え？家事しないの？
A：<u>自ら</u>進んでやることはないかも。<u>炊事</u>、洗濯、掃除は苦手
だから、母に<u>任せて</u>仕事に集中したいな。
B：いや、できる<u>範囲</u>でやりなよ。
english_translation:
A: Lately, my mother has been helping me with housework, and it's annoying.
B: Huh? You don't do housework?
A: I might not do it on my own initiative. I'm not good at cooking, laundry, or cleaning, so I want to leave it to my mother and focus on work.
B: No, you should do it within your capabilities.
